$ corvex inspect --help

--- stdout ---
Read .corvex/tasks/<project>/activity.jsonl and render a timeline:
duration, retry count, cost, and tokens for each task. Use --task to drill
into a single task's event stream, or --json for raw output.

Usage:
  corvex inspect <project> [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help          help for inspect
      --json          print machine-readable JSON instead of formatted output
      --task string   show detailed events for a single task ID (e.g. S05)

Global Flags:
      --no-color   Disable color output
  -q, --quiet      Suppress per-task progress; print only failures/errors and the final summary

--- stderr ---
(empty)

--- error ---
(nil)
